usageNotes: Use this endpoint to retrieve historical performance metrics (CPU, memory, disk I/O, network, uptime) for a specific LXC container managed by a PDM remote. The caller must hold `Resource.Audit` on the remote/guest path; the LXC must be known to the PDM remote (it need not be running, but the remote PVE node must be reachable). Use `AVERAGE` for trend graphs and `MAX` for peak-usage analysis — the two consolidation functions can return noticeably different values for bursty workloads.

examples.summary: Fetch last 24-hour average stats for LXC 101 on remote 'hetzner-pve'

tips: Both `cf` and `timeframe` are required; omitting either returns a 400 error.
RRD data points that fall in periods when the container was stopped will have most fields absent (optional fields omitted) — the `time` field is always present.
The `cpu-current` value is a fraction (0.0–1.0 per core) not a percentage; multiply by 100 × `cpu-max` for a human-readable % of total capacity.
Longer timeframes (week, month, year, decade) use coarser RRD resolution, so individual spikes visible in `hour` or `day` may be smoothed out.
The remote name must match the PDM-registered remote ID exactly (case-sensitive, 2–32 chars, alphanumeric/dot/dash/underscore).
